author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a large X chromosome with four rounded chromatid lobes, V notches and a waist at the centromere, beside a small waisted chromosome; reads as an X/Y chromosome pair instead of the letters 'Xx'. Stroke-only curved arms were tried and rejected because they read as the letters Xx.
omissions: The source's small chromosome is a thin X/Y-shaped outline; at 48px two outlined X shapes cannot fit side by side with open lobes, so the small one is a rod with a pinched centromere waist. The large chromosome's lobes form one silhouette; the source's pointed lobe tips at the centromere would pinch.
drawing_plan: Mirrored four-arm X silhouette about (14,24) with knots at every extreme; small waisted rod x 32..44 bottom-aligned.
lucide_reference: No chromosome glyph in Lucide; rounded-lobe cubics as in clover, rounded rod ends as in pill.
